install.command: download lychee-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip from the GitHub release (single binary); here: cargo install lychee --version 0.22.0 because release downloads are blocked
install.size_note: the release binary is ~15 MB; 241 s is the from-source build, not the normal install
install.windows: yes: native single binary (windows-msvc release asset)

fixtures: fixtures/05-lychee (KEY.json): site/index.html and docs/README.md with 50 links each: 12 valid internal (6 with #fragments), 4 missing files, 4 missing #fragments, 3 dead external on the reserved .invalid TLD, 27 valid external (public home/docs pages)

baseline.what: home-made offline Markdown link check (relative file exists; fragments and http ignored); nothing for HTML or external links
baseline.recall: 4/22 (4 of 8 internal defects in the Markdown file; 0 of 8 in HTML; 0 of 6 dead external)

candidate_default.config: offline mode, default settings (fragments not checked)
candidate_default.recall: 8/16 internal (all 8 missing files, 0 of 8 missing fragments); external links excluded in offline mode

candidate_tuned.recall: 16/16 internal (8 missing files + 8 missing fragments, in both HTML and Markdown)

online_mode.observed: every one of the 54 valid external links fails with 'Network error: Connection failed' because the sandbox egress proxy refuses all hosts except package registries (github.com answers 400/403 through the proxy). The 6 .invalid links were not listed in any JSON map; lychee reported 8 'excludes' without naming them. Online recall and false-positive rate must be measured locally; the fixture is ready for it (KEY.json).

limits: Online mode could not be exercised here; expect some false positives from bot-blocking sites (403/429) and set --accept and a browser-like user agent accordingly.
Offline mode does not check external links at all; it is the fast pre-commit check, online is the weekly one.
lychee 0.22 with raw URL arguments printed a Rust panic trace in this build (file inputs work); keep to file/dir inputs.
The JSON report nests results per input file; the wrapper flattens it.
verdict: ADOPT (offline mode now; online mode after a local measurement)
reason: Offline with --include-fragments finds 16/16 seeded internal defects in HTML and Markdown in 0.1 s with 0 false positives, against 4/16 for our own script. Single native binary with a Windows build.
